intro_study: According to "Archives of Pediatrics & Adolescent Medicine", tinctures for earache using Otikon Otic Solution, a naturopathic herbal extract containing Allium sativum, Verbascum thapsus, Calendula flores, and Hypericum perforatum in olive oil, have been proven to be as effective as Anaesthetic ear drops in managing ear pain associated with acute otitis media (AOM).
